name: io.github.codespar/mcp-unblockpay
description: MCP server for UnblockPay — fiat-to-stablecoin onramp/offramp, wallets, transfers

environmentVariables.name: UNBLOCKPAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the UnblockPay dashboard

environmentVariables.name: UNBLOCKPAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL. Defaults to https://api.unblockpay.com/v1. Set to https://api.sandbox.unblockpay.com/v1 to hit the sandbox.
